verdict.rationale: Perplexity has a dedicated rate-limits and usage-tiers docs page. It describes a self-serve upgrade path: spending more on API credits automatically moves you to higher tiers with more requests per minute, and tiers are never downgraded. The evidence does not show actual per-tier limit numbers or any documented concurrency caps. Missing for 10: specific published RPM/token limits per tier, documented concurrency caps, independent or hands-on corroboration of the tier mechanics.
